Update 27 February 2026:
Below are revised key milestones for the anticipated procurement related to NAWCAD Battlespace Modeling and Simulation Engineering Services Notification of Intent/Sources Sought Notice ID: N00421-25-RFPREQ-54000MA-0059. Please note that these are projected dates and are subject to change.

Key Milestones                                                           Projected Dates

Draft RFP Release                                                       FY26 QTR 3

Final RFP Release                                                       FY26 QTR 4

Proposal(s) Due                                                           FY26 QTR 4

Contract Award                                                            FY27 QTR 4

Contract Ordering Period Begins                          FY28 QTR 1

Original Posting:

The Government anticipates providing a revised projected key milestones date and/or any additional information for the anticipated procurement related to NAWCAD Battlespace Modeling and Simulation Engineering Services Notification of Intent/Sources Sought Notice ID: N00421-25-RFPREQ-54000MA-0059 by 27 February 2026.
